Endlessly optimistic, even in the rain
Suspicious of anyone in a cloak
Quick to laugh, slow to forgive
Never forgets a debt — owed or owing
Believes everything happens for a reason
Refuses to speak ill of the dead
Pretends to know more than they do
Thrives on gossip but never shares their own
Insists on paying their own way
Never sits with their back to a door
Keeps a journal of every conversation
